watch.summary: A streamer surrenders thinking he is caught in a game of prop hunt, only for the seeker to walk right past his obvious hiding spot.

beats.what: Streamer sees the seeker approaching his hiding spot.
Streamer raises his hands in surrender, accepting defeat.
The seeker walks right past him without noticing.
The seeker starts shooting paintings on the wall while ignoring the streamer.
Streamer zooms in on his prop completely sticking out out of cover.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Look at my fat ass, bro!
watch.why: The streamer's full dramatic surrender creates a great comedic contrast when the enemy completely misses him. Pointing out how exposed his prop actually was makes the enemy's obliviousness even funnier.
